coherent_ofdm.verdict: fails: delay spread >> CP, deep nulls

finding: Non-coherent multi-tone FSK (energy detection) survives the reverberant desk channel that destroys coherent CP-OFDM at every MCS. Confirms the right floor tier below OFDM-BPSK is a non-coherent MFSK/DTMF mode (delay-spread- and phase-immune), trading rate for robustness. Graceful degradation: 36.5 kbps (palm rest, coherent) -> ~0.27 kbps (desk, non-coherent).
